llm_response.reason: The site matches multiple scam characteristics: urgency tactics (hot sales), trust-building slogans (100% safe shopping, SSL), and extremely high discounts typical of scam fashion shops. No verifiable company information is present. WHOIS look-up failed, common in scam domains. The site mimics legitimate fashion retailers but exhibits strong signs of being a fraudulent shop.
